changelog: In-Chat Git & Per-Prompt Diff Inspector: Added live branch and +/- status pill in the active chat top bar (opening the shared Repo Git Hub dialog), per-response +additions/-deletions [i] chips with a detailed per-turn Git modal (operations count, modified files, inline diffs, IDE deep-links), and conversation diff badges in the history drawer
Smoother Prompt Slider Navigation: Whisper-quiet blended dot rail that wakes gently on scroll, expands smoothly on touch, and glides a thumb-tracking preview tooltip with spring motion
Storage Manager Obsidian Polish: Unified typography, neutral card hierarchy, rounded square icons, and terracotta/warm highlights aligned with Settings

Performance Optimizations: Debounced off-main TurnDiffStore persistence on Dispatchers.IO, single-flight quota refresh deduplication, hoisted prompt anchors in ChatScreen, and shared Home/In-Chat Git UI components
